treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of Malta and the Government of the People's Republic of China for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (2010), as modified by the MLI
eif_quote: Art. 30(1): "This Agreement shall enter into force thirty days from the receipt of the latter notification. This Agreement shall be applicable in respect of income derived during the taxable years beginning on or after the first day of January next following that in which this Agreement enters into force." (EIF date 2011-08-25 from STA list via map.json)
source_title: Malta S.L. 123.30 Double Taxation Relief on Taxes on Income with the People's Republic of China Order (L.N. 423 of 2011), Schedule (English text)

rates.quote: 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Royalties: Art. 12(2) second sentence - equipment royalties capped at 10% of 70% of gross (effective 7%), not modelled as separate tier. Interest: Art. 11(3) exempts interest derived by the other State's Government, local authority or agreed wholly government-owned/controlled institutions. Dividends: Art. 10(6) main-purpose clause. MLI Art. 8 does not apply (Malta reserved the entirety of Art. 8 under Art. 8(3)(a)). MLI WHT effect from 2023-01-01 (map.json; SAT Announcement 2022 No.16 lists Malta). Signature date: treaty text says 'Done at Valletta on the 23rd day of October, 2010' (matches China's MLI list 23-10-2010); STA list gives 2010.10.18 - text value used. The 2010 Agreement replaced the 1993 Agreement (Art. 30(2)).
unverified: MLI synthesised text not read; PPT quote is the MLI Art. 7(1) wording
